preconditions.description: The number of data centers n must be between 2 and 100,000.
The number of clients m must be between 1 and 100,000.
The day length h must be between 2 and 100,000.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= u[j] < h for j in range(n))
preconditions.description: Each maintenance hour u[j] for data center j must be a valid hour index between 0 and h-1.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= c[i][0] <= n and 1 <= c[i][1] <= n and c[i][0] != c[i][1] for i in range(m))
preconditions.description: Each client's data center indices must be valid and distinct.

postconditions.description: The number of data centers k included in the experiment must be between 1 and n.

postconditions.expression: len(set(x)) == k and all(1 <= x[i] <= n for i in range(k))
postconditions.description: The output must contain k distinct data center indices, each between 1 and n.

postconditions.expression: all(u[c[i][0]-1] != u[c[i][1]-1] for i in range(m))
postconditions.description: After shifting, the maintenance hours of the data centers for each client must remain distinct.
